title: T3 — Project Brief (record completed, 2026-11-22)
body:
# Project Brief — T3 PM job

## Outcome

A project manager job runs a request end to end: a charter, a planned WBS, a frozen scope
baseline, a change-requested acceptance, and a closure — and it cannot approve its own gate.

## Boundary

Out of scope: project creation and board surfaces (S05), the tool platform (T13), and the
architecture capability itself (T9). The PM path must not fork the action registry, the approval
primitives or the snapshot projection; it composes them.

## Reuse sources

- `crates/actions/src/pm/mod.rs` — `plan_project`, `changes.request`.
- `crates/store/src/spine.rs` — the baseline, gate and change primitives.
- `crates/actions/src/board/` — the charter asset and gate.
- `crates/actions/src/architecture.rs` — contracts and compliance reviews.

## Inception units

The T3 gate analysis, the candidate approaches to dual control, and the acceptance record are the
inception units; each was assessed against the live primitives rather than a new mechanism.

## Dependencies

T2 (the domain model) and P0 (the programme definition). Issue #74. The tranche-3 cadence
supplies the PI plan, objectives and the demo.

## Acceptance

SPEC_V2 §12 T3: PM runs a request end to end; cannot approve its own gate; a baseline change
requires a change request. `acceptance/programme/T3.toml` is the gate.

## Capabilities

Dual-controlled gates, the frozen scope baseline, the change-request path with its impact block,
and closure against the baseline — the capabilities the five accepted deliverables demonstrate.

## Plan

Charter → `projects.baseline` (WBS with WSJF inputs, frozen scope baseline, distinct approval) →
accepted deliverables under an approved change → delivery contract 01a2052f-29da-76c4-9bda-e45e0f408fe8 and Phase-G review →
closure review, closure gate and `projects.close`.
